label.zh-TW: App Store：TNF Taiwan（開發者網站為 thenorthface.com.tw）
label.en: App Store: TNF Taiwan (developer website on thenorthface.com.tw)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a bmai.app short link; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 若頁面導向 App 下載，請依指示操作；若沒有，請到 App Store 或 Google Play 搜尋 TNF Taiwan，只從官方上架頁安裝。
steps.en: If the page leads to an app download, follow it; if not, search for TNF Taiwan in the App Store or Google Play and install only from the official listing.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示註冊或登入會員（App Store 的說明提到以手機號碼註冊）。
steps.en: Open the app and register or log in as the app directs (the App Store listing mentions phone-number sign-up).

intro.zh-TW: 會員 App「TNF Taiwan」的分享連結；分享文案沒有提到邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: Share link for TNF Taiwan, the member app; the share text mentions no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
TNF Taiwan 是 The North Face 台灣官方網站的會員 App，可免費下載。App Store 的說明提到手機購物、收藏商品與會員優惠，以手機號碼註冊。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼，是否綁定邀請人沒有查證。分享文案只寫「推薦你下載 TNF Taiwan App」，沒有提到優惠，所以不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
TNF Taiwan is the member app of the official online shop of The North Face Taiwan, and it is free to download. The App Store listing mentions mobile shopping, saved favorites and member offers, and sign-up with a phone number.

The link on this page is the bmai.app short link from the share text and it carries no invite code; whether it is tied to a referrer was not checked. The share text only says to download the app and mentions no offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 連結原樣保留。bmai.app 是共用的第三方 App 連結服務，只因網站規則要求連結主機必須列入官方網域才列入；請不要把其他 bmai.app 網址當成 TNF 官方連結。2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 thenorthface.com.tw；手機上的轉址與邀請關係是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The link is kept exactly as shared. bmai.app is a shared third-party app-link service, listed only because the site's rules require the link host to be in the official domains; do not treat other bmai.app links as TNF official links. Opened in a desktop browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to thenorthface.com.tw; the mobile redirect and whether a referral is accepted were not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: TNF Taiwan 的分享連結有邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Is there an invite code for the TNF Taiwan share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟；App 註冊時是否有邀請碼欄位沒有查證。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, so open the link on this page. Whether the app's sign-up has a code field was not checked.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結下載 App 有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for downloading the app through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有提到優惠，本站讀到的官方頁面也沒有說明邀請優惠（會員權益、條款等頁面的內文沒有讀到），所以不列出優惠。
a.en: The share text mentions no offer, and the official pages read here describe no invite offer (member-benefits and terms text was not read), so none is listed.
